title: Polynomials, functions and graphs
summary: Function notation, polynomials, division, the remainder and factor theorems, solving polynomial equations, and graphs of cubics, polynomials, circles and hyperbolas.

cards.title: Functions and notation
cards.rule: A function gives one \(y\) for each \(x\). \(f(a)\): substitute \(x = a\).
cards.note: Vertical line test: a function's graph is hit at most once by any vertical line.

cards.title: Introducing polynomials
cards.rule: The degree is the highest power. The leading coefficient is the number in front of it.

cards.title: Expanding and simplifying
cards.rule: Multiply every term by every term, then collect like terms.

cards.title: Dividing polynomials
cards.rule: Long division: divide the leading terms, multiply, subtract, repeat.

cards.title: Remainder and factor theorems
cards.rule: Dividing \(P(x)\) by \((x - a)\) leaves \(P(a)\). If \(P(a) = 0\), \((x - a)\) is a factor.

cards.title: Solving polynomial equations
cards.rule: Factorise fully, then use the Null Factor Law.

cards.title: Cubics \(y = a(x - h)^3 + k\)
cards.rule: The point of inflection is \((h, k)\). A negative \(a\) flips it.

cards.title: Graphs of polynomials
cards.rule: Factors give the x-intercepts. A squared factor touches the axis; a cubed one flattens through it.

cards.title: Hyperbolas
cards.rule: \(y = \dfrac{a}{x - h} + k\): asymptotes \(x = h\) and \(y = k\).

cards.title: Further transformations
cards.rule: \(f(x) + k\): up \(k\). \(f(x - h)\): right \(h\). \(-f(x)\): flip in the x-axis. \(f(-x)\): flip in the y-axis.
lines: \(y = af(x)\): stretched from the x-axis by a factor of \(a\)
